title: FAx
html:
定义组：一阶证明。有序参数：E、F、R、f、r、t。

精确含义以本页公式体及其全部依赖为准。

规范公式

(@ FAx E F R f r t) 按 无捕获缩写规则 展开为下列有限公式。参数只取集合，不能填入函数项或元语言公式。

(and
  (@ FSig E F R f r)
  (or
    (exists a
      (exists b
        (and
          (@ FFm E F R f r a)
          (and
            (@ FFm E F R f r b)
            (exists z1349
              (exists z1350
                (and
                  (= z1349 a)
                  (and
                    (exists z1351 (exists z1352 (and (= z1351 b) (and (= z1352 a) (@ Node2a2 z1351 z1352 z1350)))))
                    (@ Node2a2 z1349 z1350 t)))))))))
    (or
      (exists a
        (exists b
          (exists c
            (and
              (@ FFm E F R f r a)
              (and
                (@ FFm E F R f r b)
                (and
                  (@ FFm E F R f r c)
                  (exists z1353
                    (exists z1354
                      (and
                        (exists z1355
                          (exists z1356
                            (and
                            (= z1355 a)
                            (and
                            (exists z1357 (exists z1358 (and (= z1357 b) (and (= z1358 c) (@ Node2a2 z1357 z1358 z1356)))))
                            (@ Node2a2 z1355 z1356 z1353)))))
                        (and
                          (exists z1359
                            (exists z1360
                            (and
                            (exists z1361 (exists z1362 (and (= z1361 a) (and (= z1362 b) (@ Node2a2 z1361 z1362 z1359)))))
                            (and
                            (exists z1363 (exists z1364 (and (= z1363 a) (and (= z1364 c) (@ Node2a2 z1363 z1364 z1360)))))
                            (@ Node2a2 z1359 z1360 z1354)))))
                          (@ Node2a2 z1353 z1354 t)))))))))))
      (or
        (exists a
          (exists b
            (and
              (@ FFm E F R f r a)
              (and
                (@ FFm E F R f r b)
                (exists z1365
                  (exists z1366
                    (and
                      (exists z1367
                        (exists z1368
                          (and
                            (exists z1369 (and (= z1369 a) (@ Node1a1 z1369 z1367)))
                            (and (exists z1370 (and (= z1370 b) (@ Node1a1 z1370 z1368))) (@ Node2a2 z1367 z1368 z1365)))))
                      (and
                        (exists z1371 (exists z1372 (and (= z1371 b) (and (= z1372 a) (@ Node2a2 z1371 z1372 z1366)))))
                        (@ Node2a2 z1365 z1366 t)))))))))
        (or
          (exists x
            (exists a
              (exists s
                (exists b (exists q (and (@ FSafeSub E F R f r x s a b) (and (@ FAll x a q) (@ PImp q b t))))))))
          (or
            (exists x
              (exists a
                (exists b
                  (exists ab
                    (exists qab
                      (exists qa
                        (exists qb
                          (exists rhs
                            (and
                            (@ Nat x)
                            (and
                            (@ FFm E F R f r a)
                            (and
                            (@ FFm E F R f r b)
                            (and
                            (@ PImp a b ab)
                            (and
                            (@ FAll x ab qab)
                            (and (@ FAll x a qa) (and (@ FAll x b qb) (and (@ PImp qa qb rhs) (@ PImp qab rhs t)))))))))))))))))
            (or
              (exists x
                (exists a
                  (exists q
                    (and
                      (@ Nat x)
                      (and (@ FFm E F R f r a) (and (not (@ FFree E F R f r x a)) (and (@ FAll x a q) (@ PImp a q t))))))))
              (or
                (exists s (and (@ Num1 E) (and (@ FTerm F f s) (@ FEq s s t))))
                (exists x
                  (exists a
                    (exists s
                      (exists u
                        (exists b
                          (exists c
                            (exists e
                            (exists bc
                            (and
                            (@ Num1 E)
                            (and
                            (@ FSafeSub E F R f r x s a b)
                            (and (@ FSafeSub E F R f r x u a c) (and (@ FEq s u e) (and (@ PImp b c bc) (@ PImp e bc t))))))))))))))))))))))
